_comment: This is evidence input for the generated readiness manifest, not a card backlog.
A card is IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED only when it has a record here with reproducible evidence.
Cards absent from this file are classified mechanically by scripts/gen-card-readiness:
implemented cards are IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED; remaining canonical cards are UNMATCHED_TRIAGE.
Permanent exclusions remain owned by card-exclusions.json and become NOT_PLANNED.
